item.title: Explosions reported in Venezuelan capital Caracas
item.description:
📝 A fire at Fuerte Tiuna, Venezuela's largest military complex, after a series of explosions in Caracas. Photograph: Luis Jaimes/AFP/Getty ImagesView image in fullscreenA fire at Fuerte Tiuna, Venezuela's largest military complex, after a series of explosions in Caracas. US media reported that Donald Trump had ordered the strikes against the South American country.
🔗 Read more: https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jan/03/explosions-reported-venezuela-caracas
